title: Parse command-line arguments
hints: argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="devreport") then parser.add_argument(...) once per option; parser.parse_args(argv) takes the list you give it.
type=int converts and validates; choices=[...] restricts values; action="store_true" makes a boolean flag; action="append" with dest="tags" collects repeats.
group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(); add --online and --offline to the group instead of to the parser.
Build a brand-new parser inside parse_args so the append default cannot leak between calls.
